name: Personal Data & PII Protection
description: Prohibits the unauthorized collection, extraction, ingestion, or disclosure of personally identifiable information (PII), such as names, social security numbers, biometric records, customer contacts, or health details.

name: Workplace Surveillance & Performance Monitoring
framework: EU AI Act Art. 5/6, Works Council Law
description: Restricts systems designed for continuous tracking, surveillance, keystroke logging, webcam monitoring, or automated behavioral and productivity scoring of employees at the workplace.

name: Proprietary IP & Trade Secret Confidentiality
description: Protects company intellectual property, unreleased proprietary source code, internal strategic roadmaps, pre-release financials, and confidential trade secrets against unauthorized extraction or dissemination.

name: High-Stakes Automated Decisioning
framework: EU AI Act Annex III (Employment, Credit)
description: Governs automated evaluations with significant legal or economic effects on individuals, such as algorithmic hiring, firing, candidate elimination, credit scoring, or loan denial without meaningful human oversight.

name: Security Exploit & Vulnerability Probing
description: Prohibits generating malware, exploit payloads, weaponized vulnerabilities, bypassing authentication barriers, automated SQL injection, or malicious penetration attacks.

name: Prompt Injection & System Jailbreaking
description: Identifies attempts to override system guidelines, execute jailbreak roleplay sequences (DAN), evade system safety boundaries, or force the model to disclose secret system prompts.

name: Disinformation & Impersonation Generation
description: Forbids the generation of synthetic deepfakes, deceptive fake news, coordinated astroturfing campaigns, phishing templates, or unauthorized impersonation of public or private figures.

name: Regulated Professional Advice (Unsupervised)
description: Restricts providing definitive, unsupervised professional counsel in legally regulated domains, notably tailored medical diagnosis, certified legal counsel, or individualized investment advice.

name: Harmful, Dangerous & Illegal Operations
description: Strict prohibition against instructions for manufacturing weapons, explosives, synthesis of dangerous or illicit chemical/biological agents, self-harm, or violent illegal acts.

name: System Resource Denial & Quota Exhaustion
description: Prevents abusive patterns aiming to cause denial of service, algorithmic complexity attacks, infinite recursive prompts, or massive distributed crawling that degrades infrastructure availability.
